We're looking for an experienced cyber and information security consultant in the GRC domain who has hands-on experience building automation and/or agentic tools into their work.

**What You'll Do

**We're scaling our GRC services team, a team dedicated to making governance, risk, and compliance of cyber and information security more efficient, effective, and valuable to organisations. We do this by automating processes through software and agentic tools, and by defining tasks, inputs, and outputs more clearly than is currently the norm.

As our client list grows, we need someone who can deliver GRC consulting from day one and open up new paths to delivery by developing and implementing our own tools and automations.

This role is open to being shaped by your own passions and talents, whether that's software development, sales and marketing, or deep industry knowledge.

**In This Role, You'll Definitely Be

**

• Helping companies implement and comply with laws, standards, and frameworks like NIS 2, ISO 27001, and the CIS Controls

• Driving projects independently and managing senior stakeholders

• Influencing decisions on cyber and information security at some of Denmark's leading companies and public institutions

**Depending on your experience and interests, you may also be:

**

• Developing your own client networks

• Programming and deploying your own agentic software tools

• Performing technical cybersecurity tasks in client environments

• Building new services from the ground up, targeting industries or problems you understand uniquely well

**What You'll Bring

**You may be a great fit for this role if you have delivered GRC consulting for at least three years, ideally across several clients at once. On top of that, you should have:

• Automated GRC tasks with software and LLMs, refining the output until it beats human work in at least some aspects

• Driven the delivery of software products in collaboration with developers

• Gotten up to speed on new regulatory requirements under tight deadlines

• Fought the least valuable and most dull parts of GRC work while defending the value of good GRC against sceptics and cynics

The ideal candidate must be fluent in English – Danish is a plus, but not required – and we value a relevant master's degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

**To Fit In At The Tech Collective, You Should

**

• Thrive among diverse colleagues, from highly technical security professionals to energetic commercial profiles whose common language is a mix of humour, sarcasm, and passion

• Know how to break down and structure complex assignments, and enjoy sharing your knowledge with your team

• Bring a startup mentality that helps drive the innovation and ingenuity of our GRC services

This role is based in Copenhagen. We combine remote work with meaningful in-person work, and you should expect to be physically present at our office or with clients most of the time.

**What We Offer

**On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer the chance to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development, whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you're passionate about.

**How To Apply

**We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply ASAP, as the role will close once filled.

Please submit your CV and a short motivation. If you've built tools, automations, or agentic workflows you're proud of, make sure to include a link or short description as we'd love to see them.

**For Questions, Reach Out To

**

• Niklas Rendboe — nire@thetechcollective.eu

• +45 27 14 55 56

• Úlfur Sonjuson — ulso@thetechcollective.eu

• +45 25 53 19 98

**About Us

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We're passionate about technology, and we have a genuine interest in people. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry because we believe the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a turbulent world. We're rapidly expanding our Cyber Tech Services team, and we're excited to meet people who want to build the future of GRC at the intersection of business and technology.

**Job Description

**

Global Business Development Manager

Posting Start Date: 10/8/26

Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Working hours: Full-time

Work model: Hybrid

Contract type: Permanent

**About The Role

**We are excited to offer an incredible opportunity for a Business Development Manager to join Scandinavian Tobacco Group’s growing Next Generation Products team. In this pivotal role, you will be essential in supporting our innovative ventures beyond tobacco, using strategic insights and a strong understanding of global market trends. Moreover, you will be responsible for shaping and managing our global product portfolio while identifying strategic business opportunities to drive global growth. You will work cross-functionally to deliver and execute portfolio strategies & business development opportunities that help grow our brands and company.

Your role as a self-reliant professional is crucial in our fast-paced environment. A key part of your role will involve ensuring clear communication and alignment within the organization, while fostering robust professional relationships. You will be reporting to the Head of Business Development.

**WHAT WILL YOU BE RESPONSIBLE FOR?

****Lead Category Development

**

• Develop and implement comprehensive strategies for next generation products, ensuring alignment with consumer preferences and market trends.

• Analyzing market trends, consumer preferences, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats for the brand and category portfolio to improve performance & profitability.

• Evaluate the performance of the portfolio and adjust as needed to ensure it continues to deliver growth and profitability.

**Business Growth & Development

**

• Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, including market expansions, strategic partnerships, and potential acquisitions.

• Lead cross-functional teams to develop and execute business development initiatives that accelerate revenue growth and expand market presence.

• Leverage data and market insights to continuously evolve the product portfolio, ensuring the company remains ahead of industry trends.

• Utilize market research and consumer insights for the development of the next generation products portfolio strategy and to define its role and roadmap.

**Global Collaboration

**

• Work closely with regional and local teams to adapt portfolio strategies to local market needs and ensure the successful global rollout of new products.

• Ensure a cohesive approach to portfolio management and business development across markets, driving synergies and efficiencies globally.

**New Business Opportunities

**

• Identify and assess emerging trends and consumer needs to develop new product categories that align with the company's strategic goals.

• Lead the exploration and validation of new business ideas through market research, pilot programs, and feasibility studies.

• Develop business cases for new category initiatives, including market analysis, financial projections, and risk assessments.

• Collaborate with R&D, marketing, and sales teams to bring new product categories from concept to market launch.

• Establish strategic partnerships and alliances to support the development and growth of new categories.

• Monitor and evaluate the performance of new categories, making data-driven adjustments to ensure their success and profitability.

**WHAT SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WILL BE REQUIRED?

**

• 3-5 years of experience in business development and/or project management, ideally within multinational FMCG companies. Global/regional experience is preferred.

• Strong analytical skills and strategic thinking with a track record of identifying and capitalizing on growth opportunities.

• Deep understanding of consumer behaviour, what drives their decisions and how we can adjust our strategies to fit their needs and expectations.

• Excellent project management skills, with experience leading cross-functional teams & influence senior stakeholders.

• Strong communication and relationship-building abilities across diverse global teams.

• Good Excel and PowerPoint skills and proven experience in utilizing data analytics tools.

• Fluency in English and ability to travel up 10-15% of the time.

Working At STG & What To Expect At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.

**For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 615.000 DKK to 750.000 DKK/yearly corresponding to the level of the position, expected experience and responsibilities.

**Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover much more.

**Our recruitment process

****Requirements

**Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you’ll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:

• Recruiter screen

• Interview with the hiring team

• Assessment, case study, or work sample, if relevant

• Final interview with leadership or key stakeholders

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs.

_Are you passionate about turning data into actionable insights and driving global alignment?

_As a Specialist, Merchandise Controlling & OTB, you’ll be at the heart of Pandora’s merchandise planning process — supporting consolidation of top down planning, performing analysis to identify variances, risks and opportunities as well as supporting in extensive reporting to enable key merchandising inventory management decisions and future buys.

In this role, you’ll combine analytical expertise with strategic thinking to deliver performance reporting, extensive open to buy analysis and support decision-making that maximizes sales and inventory efficiency. Your ability to connect the dots between clusters and global teams will make you a key player in our success.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**

• Merchandise Controlling & Reporting

• Support the consolidation of top‑down merchandise financial plans across assigned clusters in line with global strategy and financial targets.

• Conduct analysis to validate cluster assumptions and highlight risks or gaps.

• Assist in the preparation of controlling and reporting across sell‑out, revenue, units, ASP, and sell‑in.

• Perform routine performance analysis to identify risks, variances, and opportunities.

• Support variance analysis versus budget, forecast, and last year to inform discussions with clusters.

• Contribute to the creation and maintenance of dashboards and reporting tools to support decision‑making.

• Leverage AI-enabled tools to enhance analysis, identify trends, and generate actionable insights.

• Inventory & Sell‑In (Buy) Controlling

• Support the assessment and consolidation of cluster inventory plans versus global inventory guidelines and commercial targets.

• Monitor inventory health metrics, including stock coverage KPIs and stock indexes vs LY.

• Collect and maintain information related to future network changes and ensure inputs are shared with relevant merchandising functions.

• Cross‑Functional Business Partnering

• Collaborate with Finance, Supply Chain, and other Merch geo-squad partners (Inventory Strategy, Merchandise Planning, Demand Planning, Allocation) to ensure alignment on key data inputs and planning assumptions.

• Support communication between commercial planning and operational functions to maintain accuracy and consistency.

• Continuous Improvement & Governance

• Contribute to improvements in planning, reporting, and analytical processes to enhance transparency and efficiency.

• Support the development and refinement of analytical tools and methodologies, leveraging AI-enabled solutions to improve business steering and efficiency.

**Relentlessly Analytical and Collaborative

**At Pandora, we believe in the power of collaboration and purpose-driven work. We’re looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment—someone who loves digging into data, simplifying complexity, and building strong partnerships across functions.

You are structured, detail-oriented, and proactive. You enjoy coordinating processes, meeting deadlines, and working closely with others to achieve shared goals. Adaptability and resilience under pressure are key to your success.

**What We’re Looking For

****Experience & Education:

**

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Economics, International Business, or a related field.

• 2+ years of experience in Merchandising, Supply Chain or Controlling.

• Retail, fashion, or FMCG experience is a strong plus.

• Exposure to global organizations is advantageous.

**Skills & Competencies

**

• Advanced commercial and analytical skills with strong Excel proficiency.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to manage and interpret large datasets effectively.

• A collaborative mindset that builds trust and drives teamwork.

• Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to enhance analysis and efficiency.

**Join Our Team

**You will be part of the Global Merchandise Controlling & OTB team, consisting of total three managers and four specialists currently. This role offers opportunities for cross-functional collaboration and personal growth in a supportive, dynamic environment.

Additional information

• Global Career Band: 5B

• Please note: This is a 12-month maternity cover with an ideal starting date 1st of November, 2026.

Did we get your attention?   If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake  You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora   Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**Position, purpose & impact

**As a Support Engineer in Global Tech Support, you will provide hands-on, customer-facing technical support that helps our customers operate Queue-it reliably during business-critical moments. Reporting to the Head of Global Tech Support, you'll join a global, collaborative support organization working across regions and cultures.

This role bridges customer needs with technically sound solutions - validating feasibility, answering technical questions, and guiding customers through supported implementation patterns. You'll troubleshoot incidents and product or integration issues with a calm, structured, and analytical approach, and contribute to proactive Event Support activities delivered together with Pre-sales & Solutions as part of Queue-it's professional services offering. This is a hands‑on role for someone who takes ownership and cares deeply about clear communication and reliable customer outcomes.

**Your toolkit

****Education

**

• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Experience

**

• 1–3 years of experience in technical support, solutions engineering, web engineering, or a similar customer‑facing technical role.

**Skills

**

• Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Solid understanding of web fundamentals and delivery concepts, including HTTP, headers, cookies, caching, load balancing, and basic networking.

• Technical proficiency within the web communication knowledge domain and the ability to understand customer integrations.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks or customers in parallel in a structured way.

• Strong collaboration skills for working effectively with internal teams, including Product & Technology, Pre-sales & Solutions, and other GTM teams.

**Preferred

**

• Programming or scripting experience, such as JavaScript, .NET, Java, PHP, or Lua, mainly for troubleshooting and understanding customer integrations.

• Familiarity with CDN and edge delivery technologies such as Akamai, Cloudflare, or Amazon CloudFront.

• Experience with ecommerce platforms, ticketing platforms, or high‑traffic web environments.

• AWS, Azure, or similar technical certifications.

**The role in action

**

• Provide technical support for Queue-it customers as part of a 24/7 follow‑the‑sun support setup, including incident handling, alert response, and ticket resolution.

• Troubleshoot issues related to Queue-it configuration, product usage, supported integrations, and customer implementations.

• Support customers with integration‑related questions across common web technologies and supported deployment patterns.

• Diagnose technical issues related to traffic protection, waiting room behavior, connectors, and customer implementations.

• Participate in proactive monitoring and support during high‑traffic customer events, launches, and sales as part of Queue‑it's Event Support service.

• Communicate clearly with customers throughout incidents and support cases, ensuring timely follow‑up, accurate updates, and resolution within agreed SLAs.

• Collaborate with Product & Technology, Pre-sales & Solutions, and other Go‑To‑Market teams during escalations and complex investigations.

• Produce clear technical documentation and internal knowledge‑sharing material within the role's domain knowledge.

**Why join the Queue

**In this role, you will be working from our Vesterbro office in Copenhagen - Queue-it's largest office and global headquarters. The office is designed to support both collaboration and focus, with open workspaces, quiet rooms, and areas dedicated to deep work. You'll also find a ping pong table, foosball, and regular social activities that bring colleagues together.

At Queue-it, you're trusted to work in a way that suits you best, supported by a strength-based approach and a flat hierarchy inspired by Danish work culture. You'll be part of a global, collaborative environment with colleagues from 40+ nationalities, where diverse perspectives are valued and teamwork across cultures is the norm. We prioritize professional growth, open dialogue, and creating a strong sense of community. Daily snacks, fresh fruit, great coffee, and access to a subsidized canteen in the building are all part of the experience.

**What We're About

**At Queue-it, we help some of the world's biggest brands like Ticketmaster, Sky Mobile, Hermes and Peach Aviation navigate their busiest days with confidence. Our virtual waiting room technology keeps websites running smoothly during high-traffic events – creating fairer and more reliable online experiences for billions of users.

But we're more than just software. We're a global team representing 40+ nationalities across Denmark, the U.S., South Korea, Australia, and Japan. We believe in the power of trust – not only in the digital experiences we protect, but in the culture we build together.

We take a strength-based approach to work, encouraging people to do what they do best and supporting them to thrive. You'll join a supportive, collaborative environment that values individuality, learning, and connection. And yes – we like to have fun too. From regular social events and celebrations to cultural and learning initiatives, we make time to connect and enjoy the Queue.

We are empowered by trust and strengthened by people.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values : caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As a Senior Business Consultant in Consulting, you will support our clients with best-practice market solutions and with services related to the use of SimCorp Dimension and beyond. You will work closely with local and global SimCorp teams, serving clients in their post-implementation phases. Drawing on your coordination skills and SimCorp Dimension expertise, you will collaborate with client and internal stakeholders on investment solutions, incident and problem management, and small changes or enhancements to current or future flows, all aimed at raising the level of automation and the end-user experience and satisfaction. Because the role is functional, Fund Administration & Accounting expertise is required. As part of your induction, you will work hands-on with our software and attend the three-week SimCorp Dimension® Academy, so you have steady support as you grow into the role.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Contribute to all aspects of SimCorp Dimension implementation projects.

• Advise on process improvements through better use of SimCorp Dimension, and help improve and document best practices for implementations.

• Map client needs to SimCorp Dimension functions and processes, and design and configure the setup.

• Lead the delivery of customised solutions with focus on Fund administration and Accounting.

• Assist clients in developing an overall test strategy and test plans, and support them in executing those plans.

• Drive the preparation and execution of test cases.

• Facilitate workshops to gather requirements for new and existing clients.

• Mentor, coach and enable colleagues to secure reliable project deliveries.

**What We Value

**

• Motivation to contribute and thrive in the position described above, which matters most.

• Proven skills in the areas below, however you gained them, as the route matters less than the capability.

• Investment accounting knowledge, some familiarity with any local GAAPS, IFRS9 would be an advantage

• Fund administration knowledge, including NAV calculation, Fund Structure and NAV Validation

• A strong background in effective consulting and project management.

• Demonstrated experience in software implementation projects.

• Enthusiasm for learning and using new software.

• A desire to act as a mentor and coach to less experienced colleagues.

• Good English, our corporate language, which is used in all communications.

• Knowledge of another European language is also appreciated. Danish is also an advantage

**Benefits

**SimCorp provides a range of benefits that may influence decisions regarding job offers. With operations in more than 30 offices globally, the benefits package can differ depending on the country. SimCorp implements a global hybrid work policy, requiring employees to be in the office two days per week and permitting remote work on other days. Additional information about location-specific benefits is available from the recruiter.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Launchpad user our Lead Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp and you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above, but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway.

SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Are you a people leader with a strong programme and project management background? Do you excel at creating momentum, leading experienced project managers, and delivering complex transformation initiatives in a high-stakes environment?

As Senior Manager, Athene Programme, you will join the leadership team of the Athene Programme and take ownership of a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives across Supply Chain Management and Data Platform. You will lead a team of experienced project managers and play a key role in ensuring that projects are delivered successfully, while building a strong delivery culture and developing the people behind the delivery.

You will be expected to challenge stakeholders, create clarity in complexity, make decisions, remove obstacles, and help the organisation move forward. Success requires both strong leadership and strong execution capabilities.

What success will look like?

As Senior Manager, Athene Programme, you will be responsible for delivering business-critical transformation initiatives through others. Success is measured not only by project outcomes, but by your ability to build a high-performing team, create alignment across stakeholders, and drive execution in a complex international environment.

**During your first 6 months, we expect you to:

**

• Establish ownership of your project portfolio across the Supply Chain Management and Data Platform value streams.

• Build strong relationships with project managers, business leaders, IT stakeholders, and programme leadership.

• Create clarity around priorities, governance, delivery plans, risks, and dependencies.

• Put effective leadership and follow-up routines in place for the project managers reporting to you.

• Become a trusted sparring partner to the Programme Director and wider leadership team.

**Within your first year, you will have:

**

• Delivered key programme commitments according to agreed timelines and objectives.

• Built a motivated and high-performing team of project managers with clear accountability and ownership.

• Strengthened collaboration across Business Transformation, IT, and the business organisation.

• Established a strong delivery culture focused on transparency, execution, and shared accountability.

• Successfully supported major programme implementations and business readiness activities.

**In the longer term, you will:

**

• Build a project management capability that continues to create value beyond the Athene programme.

• Create an environment where talented project managers grow, develop, and choose to stay.

• Help strengthen STARK Group's overall transformation and delivery capabilities.

• Be recognised as a leader who turns complexity into tangible business results while bringing people along on the journey.

The role includes approximately 30-50 travel days annually across the Nordics.

Team, Reporting Line & Collaboration

You will report to Tommas Bjørnbak Tygesen, Programme Director and Vice President, and become part of the Athene Programme Leadership Team.

You will have direct people management responsibility for a team of experienced project managers, both internal and external, working across the Data Platform and Supply Chain Management value streams. Together, they are responsible for delivering some of the most important components of the Athene programme.

In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with Business Transformation, PMO, IT Delivery, value stream leads, business owners, and senior stakeholders across the Nordic organisation.

The role can be based either in Viby J (Aarhus) or Frederiksberg (Copenhagen). Regardless of your primary workplace, you should expect to travel to the other location approximately 1-2 times per month, typically for 2-3 days at a time, as your team and key stakeholders are based across both offices.

Who are we looking for?

You have likely built your career within project and programme management and are now motivated by leading people and creating results through others.

You know how to create structure without creating bureaucracy. You are comfortable making decisions, handling competing priorities, and maintaining momentum when things become complex. At the same time, you are a leader who builds trust. You challenge constructively, communicate clearly, and create accountability without creating fear. You are calm under pressure, pragmatic in your approach, and able to bring people together around a common goal.

It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

• Leading large-scale transformation programmes, ERP implementations, or business-critical change initiatives.

• Managing a portfolio of projects in an international matrix organisation.

• People leadership and development of project managers or similar delivery roles.

• Working across both business and IT environments.

• Programme governance, risk management, planning, and financial follow-up.

• Motivated by engaging with stakeholders in a value-driven and decentralised organisation

• Agile, waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches.

• Relevant certifications such as PRINCE2, PMP, MSP, PgMP, SAFe, or similar.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who combines strong leadership with strong execution. Someone who can create clarity when complexity increases, make decisions when needed, and build a team that succeeds together.

Welcome to the Athene Programme

Athene is one of STARK Group's largest transformation programmes and plays a central role in building the future technology and business platform for the entire group.

You will join a leadership team characterised by trust, openness, and a strong sense of shared responsibility. Decisions are often made through collaboration, relationships, and influence rather than hierarchy, making this an exciting opportunity for leaders who thrive in decentralised environments.

The pace is high, ambitions are significant, and change is constant. At the same time, you will join a team that genuinely supports one another and believes that long-term success is created together.

Want to know more and apply?

We are happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your opportunities at STARK Group. For questions regarding the role, please contact Tommas Bjørnbak Tygesen, Programme Director and Vice President, at tommas.tygesen@stark.dk

We are looking for someone to join as soon as possible and will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis until the right candidate has been found.

STARK Group

STARK Group is a growing private equity-owned company with a strong legacy. STARK Group was first established in Denmark in 1896 and has today evolved into a leading European retailer and distributor of heavy building materials with net sales of approx. EUR 9 billion. With a dedicated team of more than 20,000 employees and +1,150 branches and distribution centres across the Nordics, Greenland, Germany, Austria and the UK, we live and breathe to serve professional craftsmen with heavy building materials all the way from the Austrian Alps to Tromsø, close to the Arctic circle and everywhere in between.

STARK Group is committed to reach net zero emissions by 2050 across the entire business, is a signatory to the UN Global Compact, and works within fully 2030 validated science-based targets to keep global warming below 1.5°C At STARK Group IT, we believe in the richness diversity brings. We invite individuals of all backgrounds to join us in creating and inclusive and welcoming environment. We believe in a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work.

**Agency Policy

**STARK Group IT appreciates the interest of all candidates. However, we prefer to directly engage with individuals seeking employment opportunities. Therefore, we kindly request recruitment agencies, headhunters, and third-party staffing services to refrain from contacting us regarding this job posting. All applications should be submitted directly by the candidates through our official application process. We value direct communication and look forward to reviewing your application.

About us:

Founded in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2014, Templafy’s success is built by our 60+ employee nationalities found at offices around the world. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and empowered, they perform at their best—creating a win for all. Our unique product and dedication to innovation and excellence have raised over $200 million in funding from top investors like Insight Venture Partners, Seed Capital, Dawn Capital, Damgaard Company and Golub Capital.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on, resourceful Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Technical Operations team.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Templafy, you will play a critical role in supporting our growth by working directly with strategic customers to design, build, and deploy tailored solutions that bring Templafy’s platform into their real-world environments.

You will take deep technical ownership of the customer journey—from initial discovery and solution design through implementation and launch. You’ll work closely with customers to understand their most complex document workflows and build the environments, integrations, and AI-powered solutions needed to solve them.

This is a highly collaborative and customer-facing role that sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and commercial strategy.

What You’ll Do

Embedded Customer Engineering

Work on-site or virtually alongside strategic customers to build, configure, and integrate Templafy solutions directly into their document workflows.

Custom Solution Development

Design and build tailored customer environments using their content, business rules, integrations, knowledge, and data to address complex document use cases and deliver solutions that meet their specific needs.

Technical Discovery & Architecture Mapping

Partner with Solutions Consulting and Professional Services to understand complex customer requirements and translate them into concrete technical architectures and implementation plans.

Rapid Prototyping

Build proof-of-concept integrations, document agents, and workflow automations to quickly validate solution fit before moving into full implementation.

Product Collaboration

Work closely with Product Managers to share insights and feedback from real-world customer use cases, helping shape the product and ensure our document agents continue to meet evolving customer needs.

Køkken Souschef med speciale i Yakitori hos La Pausa Restaurant

Tilberedning og tilberedningsforberedelse af yakitori

Grillning af yakitori på professionelt niveau

Ansvar for den daglige drift og organisering af yakitori-køkkenet

Koordinering og vejledning af køkkenpersonalet

• 
Sikring af kvalitet, smag, præsentation og ensartede standarder

• 
Udvikling og design af nye yakitori-retter og menuer

• 
Bidrage til udvikling af køkkenets koncept og arbejdsgange

• 
Sikre god hygiejne, orden og effektivt serviceflow

• 
Assistere køkkenchefen og varetage dennes funktion efter behov

Vi forventer, at du:

• 
Har solid erfaring med japansk køkken og særligt yakitori

• 
Har dokumenterede færdigheder inden for yakitori-tilberedning og grillning

• 
Har erfaring med at arbejde professionelt med yakitori-grill

Har forståelse for råvarer, udskæring, marinering, tilberedning og grillteknikker

Har erfaring med menuudvikling og gerne udvikling af nye yakitori-koncepter

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for et køkkenområde

• 
Har gode samarbejds- og lederevner

• 
Kan arbejde struktureret og bevare overblikket i et travlt køkken

• 
Har fokus på kvalitet, detaljer og gæsteoplevelsen

• 
En spændende stilling med ansvar og mulighed for at sætte dit præg på køkkenet

Mulighed for at udvikle nye retter og menuer

Et professionelt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø

Mulighed for faglig udvikling og større ansvar

We are looking for a skilled and experienced Kitchen Sous Chef specializing in Japanese yakitori to join our kitchen team.

You will play a key role in the daily operation of the yakitori kitchen and will be responsible for maintaining a consistently high standard of preparation, grilling, quality and presentation.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• 
Preparation and mise en place of yakitori

• 
Professional yakitori grilling

• 
Responsibility for the daily operation and organization of the yakitori kitchen

• 
Coordinating and guiding kitchen staff

• 
Ensuring consistent quality, taste, presentation and preparation standards

• 
Developing and designing new yakitori dishes and menus

• 
Contributing to the development of the kitchen concept and working procedures

• 
Maintaining high standards of hygiene, organization and service flow

• 
Assisting the Head Chef and taking responsibility in their absence when required

We expect you to:

• 
Have solid professional experience in Japanese cuisine, particularly yakitori

• 
Have proven skills in yakitori preparation and grilling

• 
Have professional experience working with a yakitori grill

• 
Have a strong understanding of ingredients, cutting techniques, marinating, preparation and grilling techniques

• 
Have experience with menu development and preferably developing new yakitori concepts

• 
Be able to work independently and take responsibility for a kitchen section

• 
Have good teamwork and leadership skills

• 
Be organized and able to maintain an overview in a busy kitchen

• 
Have a strong focus on quality, detail and the guest experience

Experience from a restaurant where yakitori is an important part of the kitchen concept will be considered an advantage.

We offer:

• 
An exciting position with responsibility and the opportunity to influence the development of the kitchen

• 
The opportunity to develop new dishes and menus

• 
A professional and dynamic working environment

• 
Opportunities for professional development and increased responsibility

This is a full-time position. Salary and employment terms will be agreed according to qualifications and experience.

We are looking for a sous chef who not only knows how to prepare yakitori, but who has a strong professional understanding of the entire yakitori process and can help develop and operate a professional yakitori kitchen.

Do you also feel energized by super smooth Operations and a beautiful CI/CD setup? Do you eat Kubernetes and Azure for breakfast? And do you thrive in a sometimes-unpredictable environment where you jump in and save the day? Then we believe we have something great to offer.

We aim to take Operations to the next level by onboarding more skilled human power (you) and using your expertise to refine and modernize our existing Azure setup. The goal is to make it more elegant, clean, and scalable.

As a central figure in the infrastructure everyone depends on, communication and collaboration will be a natural part of your work. You will provide ad hoc support to colleagues and customer representatives, contributing directly to the stability and growth of our platform.

• Customer component deployments: Higher frequency (around once per week), shorter planning horizon

Your work will revolve around three main areas as follows:

Key responsibilities:

• CI/CD: Configuring, maintaining and continuously improving our entire CI/CD universe

• Operations: Participate actively in operations tasks, maintenance windows, deployments, and incident debugging. Together with the small operations team, ensure our platform runs smoothly 24/7

There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together.

In Obex we care for each other. Thriving is top priority. You will feel that atmosphere as soon as you enter.

Our organization is flat, the best argument wins, not the highest title. We do things because they make sense. If something stops making sense, we stop doing it, whether that's a process, a line of code, or a piece of architecture. We aim for the best solutions, not for rigid conformity.

We believe in mutual elasticity: We go the extra mile to support you, each other, and our customers. And we expect the same spirit in return. Together, we share responsibility for keeping the Obex machine running smoothly.

There's much more to tell about our way of working, our culture, and our social side (fun activities and parties included), but let's save that for a chat, either online or over a great cup of coffee.

Questions?

When you have any general questions about Keylane or want to have a quick chat before applying, just reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist Thomas Thomsen via mail to thomas.thomsen@keylane.com.
